name: unsafe-log-secret
title: Do not log secrets
lesson: Logs are durable, shared, and searchable. A password in a log is a password leak.
fix_goal: Keep the event useful while redacting the secret value.
fix_steps: Keep useful fields such as severity, event, user, and outcome.
Replace the raw password with a fixed redaction marker.
Re-run ./lab.sh and verify this lab moves to FIXED.
